Entries.Observed: The root has errors: preproc_if contains nested if_statement nodes, an ERROR over #else [37,42), and a missing semicolon at byte 53. The shared block [61,64) is parsed as a separate sibling instead of the body of the if head that either branch selects.
Entries.Expected: C# conditional compilation operates during lexical analysis: only the selected section supplies ordinary tokens, and unselected sections are skipped source text. Whether A is defined or undefined, this input selects one complete if head followed by the shared block. Either selection is a valid program, and so is the source with the directive lines removed (two nested if statements), so this input is a grammar defect: the grammar models #if/#else/#endif as a node holding whole statements. Inputs whose branches cannot be combined without evaluating symbols (for example a { opened in each branch) are an inherent limit of parsing every branch and are not claimed here. The register records only this input; it does not require a particular tree for inactive text.
